description_en: Queries the IP list of a domain name
kebab_example: aliyun vod describe-vod-user-vips-by-domain --domain-name example.com --available on --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeVodUserVipsByDomain

parameters.help_en: The accelerated domain name for ApsaraVideo VOD. Only a single domain name can be queried
